scenes.title: One amino acid, stalled endosomes
scenes.caption: One amino acid swap, cysteine to arginine at position 112, is a major genetic risk factor for late-onset Alzheimer's disease. Yet in automated APOE4 literature mining, extraction struggled where science depends on it most: grounding every claim in primary experimental data.

scenes.title: Deterministic extraction meets 3D provenance
scenes.caption: For the MecCog Challenge, Team Khepri paired a strict Step 1 extraction pipeline with an interactive Mol* 3D workbench. Under Rule C5, our Excel spreadsheets hold only verbatim literature quotes, panel locations, and printed statistics, separated cleanly from 3D structural models.

scenes.title: The Arg112–Glu109 conformational switch
scenes.caption: In crystal structure 1B68, APOE4's arginine 112 forms a 2.53 Angstrom salt bridge with glutamate 109, displacing arginine 61 outward from 3.53 to 5.34 Angstroms compared to APOE3 structure 1NFN, consistent with altered domain interaction.

scenes.title: Hypothesized two-stage endosomal bottleneck
scenes.caption: Across two hypotheses, that structural shift is hypothesized to drive two organellar choke points. Under H2, impaired NHE6 proton-leak regulation traps ApoER2 and LRP1 receptors in early endosomes. Under H5, ABCA1 and NPC1 lipid-export defects sequester cholesterol in lysosomes, elevating lysosomal pH and blunting beta-amyloid clearance.

scenes.title: Twenty-eight unique papers, zero errors
scenes.caption: Every line is reproducible and physician-audited: 30 entries covering 28 unique primary papers across H5 and H2, yielding 120 experimental findings, 126 printed-in-text statistics with panel locations, zero retracted or review papers, and zero errors or warnings under strict validation.

scenes.title: What contradicts and where models stop
scenes.caption: Honest boundaries matter just as much as support: we report 29 contradicting findings directly in the sheets. Neuronal NHE6 ablation rescues ApoER2 trafficking in vivo, whereas APOE4 astrocytes lose NHE6 and require NHE6 activation; H2 rests purely on Tier 2 models, and 4 gated or paywalled papers remain abstract-only rather than bypassed.
